verdict.headline: Nothing beat the S&P 500 well enough to use, so the system holds the S&P 500.
verdict.detail: None of the 23 testable angles passed the pre-registered gate (t ≥ 3, deflated Sharpe ≥ 0.95, right sign in ≥ 60% of windows, factor alpha t ≥ 2) on 1996–2015 data. The locked 2016–2026 holdout, opened once, backed the gate: the best-looking angles before 2016 faded or reversed afterward, and none would have passed. So the portfolio is plain cap weight, plus one small rule: buy index additions 5 trading days late.

holdout.note: SYSTEM is the S&P 500 reconstructed from CRSP (through 2024) and Yahoo (2025+) at total-share cap weights, plus rule I3. It is not float-adjusted, so a gap vs VOO of a few tenths of a percent a year is reconstruction noise, not skill. The comparison that isolates the research decision is SYSTEM vs BASE0 (the I3 effect).
